declared_before_results: partially: see prior_knowledge. No V2A/V2B statistic below had been computed when this file was checksummed, but the V1 summary already exposed some horizon means.
study_kind_meaning: Same C-M V1 candidates, same controls, same 240-day primary window that produced GATE-C2 = FAIL. A SUPPORTED/label outcome here is a hypothesis for a future out-of-sample test, never a trading approval and never a reversal of GATE-C2.

reused_unchanged: features, eligibility, hard filter, history, CA exclusions
variants C-M0, C-M1, C-M2 and their thresholds
matching cell (signal_date, price_bucket, atr_bucket, adv20_bucket), min 5 label-valid controls
label CA suspicion (D..D+10) and DISAPPEARED censoring
primary window idx 251..N-10 (240 dates), secondary idx 60..N-10 (M0/M1 only), 4 time blocks
baseline.must_reproduce: V1 horizon 1/3/5/10 candidate and control means for every variant within 1e-12, else the run aborts

prior_knowledge: V1 summary (read before this declaration) already reports candidate vs matched-control mean close at horizons 1/3/5/10: excess is <= +0.13%p in all 12 cells and negative in 10 of 12 (e.g. C-M0: -0.10, -0.13, -0.01, -0.06 %p).
V1 reports MFE10 excess +1.8..+2.9%p and MAE10 excess -1.5..-1.9%p in simple-return terms.

Therefore V2A is expected to be REJECTED before running; the declaration exists so the result cannot be steered. The log-space asymmetry of V2B was chosen because simple-return MFE/MAE are mechanically asymmetric under higher volatility (e^x - 1 > 1 - e^-x), not because of any computed V2B value.

labels.close_return_k: same formula as V1: C(last traded session in D+1..D+k) / P0 - 1, clipped to [-1, 1]
labels.overnight_gap_reference: open(D+1)/close(D) - 1 on the split-normalized series; descriptive only, not tradable by a signal that exists after D's close
labels.time_to_mfe_10: 1-based offset of first session at the 10D high
labels.time_to_mae_10: 1-based offset of first session at the 10D low
labels.post_mfe_retrace_j: for j in 1,2,3: C(D + time_to_mfe_10 + j) / Hmax_10 - 1, using the ticker's bar on that session; NaN when that session has no bar (counted)
labels.giveback_10: (Hmax_10 - C_10) / (Hmax_10 - P0) for rows with mfe_10 > 0; share of the peak gain returned by D+10

c_v2a_short_horizon.validity_per_horizon: V1 LabelSet.valid(k): entry bar, no label CA suspicion (D..D+10 for every k), not DISAPPEARED at k
c_v2a_short_horizon.matched_base: control mean of the label in the candidate's cell over controls valid at the same k

statistics.mean_excess_k: candidate mean close_k minus matched base mean, ratio-of-sums per date as in V1 _diff_ci
statistics.median_excess_k: median over matched candidates of (close_k - cell control mean close_k)
statistics.family: 3 variants x 7 horizons = 21 two-sided tests; Bonferroni level 1 - 0.05/21 = 99.7619%

per_variant_horizon_conditions.d_secondary_window_same_sign: M0/M1 only: secondary mean excess > 0; M2 has no secondary window and is judged on a..c

supported_rule.SUPPORTED: at least one (variant, horizon in 1..5) meets every condition
supported_rule.WEAK_DESCRIPTIVE: no SUPPORTED cell, but some (variant, horizon in 1..5) has 95% unadjusted CI low > 0 and >= 3 of 4 positive blocks; recorded, not SUPPORTED
supported_rule.cost_reference: 0.25%p round trip is printed beside every excess; it is not a gate condition

metrics.realized_vol_k: sample std (ddof 1) of daily log returns r_1 = ln(C(D+1)/P0), r_j = ln(C(D+j)/C(D+j-1)) for j=2..k; requires a bar on every session D+1..D+k else NaN (counted)
metrics.atr_expansion_k: mean true range over D+1..D+k (TR uses the previous session's close, D's close for D+1) divided by P0, divided by the pre-signal atr_pct feature; same all-bars requirement

c_v2b_volatility_expansion.statistics: per metric: candidate mean - matched control mean (same cell, controls valid for that metric), block bootstrap 10000; family 3 variants x 3 decision tests (log_up_10, log_down_10, log_asym_10) plus range_10 and close_10 = 15 tests -> Bonferroni 1 - 0.05/15 = 99.6667%

classification_per_variant.inputs: U = log_up_10 excess, Dn = log_down_10 excess, A = log_asym_10 excess, R = range_10 excess, C = close_10 excess; 'pos' means Bonferroni CI low > 0, 'neg' means CI high < 0, 'zero' means CI contains 0
rules: U zero and Dn zero and R zero
R pos and (C pos or A pos)
U pos and (Dn zero or Dn neg)
U pos and Dn pos and A zero and C zero
R pos and C zero and A neg (downside-skewed expansion)
anything else, printed with its inputs

c_v2b_volatility_expansion.overall_label: the label shared by at least 2 of the 3 variants; otherwise MIXED
c_v2b_volatility_expansion.trading_strategy: none; this study only labels what information C-M carries
